notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/10
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]- Fixed an interface display issue related to high resolutions[/p][p]- For the Great Deaf and his heirs, only text names will be allowed, limited to 12 characters, because no one can have a name longer than Aquasplendere[/p][p]- In case of force majeure, ships will be able to pass through the Temple of Aquasplendere if there is no other way[/p][p]- Added additional information about the plot type in the Great Whisperer's bubble when hovering over a small infrastructure[/p][p]- Right-clicking on infrastructure statuettes will no longer make a sound[/p][p]- The "Destroy Infrastructure" button should no longer select plots below[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused the Great Whisperer's bubble to flash when hovering over it in addition to hovering over a plot[/p][p]- Hovering over a plot where a ship was located while choosing the waterfall for the future Temple will no longer display information about it[/p][p]- Fixed a display bug for the minimum number of waterfalls mission on the future level[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze after destroying a Priority Housing[/p][p]- Shifted the Great Eye tutorial regarding the Tutoring age restriction to the next level[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice day or evening.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/09
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][p]- Fixed a bug with waterfalls so that they wouldn't stagnate on their own, without a water connection[/p][p]- Hovering over an interface cancels the selection of the last infrastructure hovered over, avoiding opening an unwanted infrastructure sheet[/p][p]- The impact of the Great Deaf's ages has been added from the second level instead of the first to facilitate the first Great Choice[/p][p]- More transactions have been added for large infrastructures because they produce too quickly compared to the supply of materials[/p][p]- Building an Embankment will remove the water present on the plot if its quantity is less than 1 m3[/p][p]- Rewritten the descriptive sentence for the Hole (adding a clarification about digging in water)[/p][p]- Rewritten the descriptive sentence for the Embankment (adding a clarification about stacking them)[/p][p]- Visual overhaul of the area of ​​influence of an infrastructure[/p][h3][/h3][h3]Tutorials[/h3][p]- Tutorial on selecting the next Temple position rewritten[/p][p]- Tutorial on the People's Anger and its evolution rewritten[/p][p]- Tutorial on terraforming using the Hole rewritten[/p][p]- Tutorial on the Great Deaf's ages shifted to the second level[/p][p]- Tutorial on fire hazards added[/p][p][/p][p]Have a good day or evening.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/07
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed a bug that didn't take into account the duration of the first month when loading a game, switching directly to the next month[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash if paused before launching the Great Cohort[/p][p]- Ambient sound now matches music when changing game speed[/p][p]- Ships update correctly when the map is rotated at 0 game speed[/p][p]- New change to the area of ​​influence: it now has a relief so it's clearly visible[/p][p]- The text color of the “Launch Cohort” button on the Cohort sheet has been lightened[/p][p]- Hovering over the bottom interface should no longer generate Great Whisperer bubbles when hovering over plots

Have a nice day or evening.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update - 2025/06/06
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][p]- When the game speed is at 0 during the tutorial, it will automatically reset to 0 during the next tutorial[/p][p]- Improved water flow to prevent a low-level plot near a waterfall from being unirrigated[/p][p]- Fixed the display of the total amount of materials for an infrastructure in the interface[/p][p]- Inactive population mission rewritten[/p][p]- The Great Whisperer's information about plots will now correctly hide when hovering over a sheet[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where clicking on the cross or + button of the ship construction would select plots[/p][p]- Minimum amount of materials transportable by a ship has been set to 1 (in order to empty infrastructures correctly in the event of a lack of materials)[/p][p]- Changing the Import/Export status of a commodity now correctly updates the Great Whisperer's bubble[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that did not open the Temple sheet linked to a tutorial correctly when loading a game[/p][p]- Exiting the Pause menu resets the speed selected before pausing[/p][p]- Display of a "Some ships are stuck" message when ships cannot find their way to an infrastructure[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that generated ships built on a plot of land instead of a water plot[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that displayed the same information in the Great Whisperer's bubble when a selected building moved from one valid plot to another[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that left water-based infrastructures active when they were no longer on the water[/p][p]- Negative impact of the Sage increased[/p][p][/p][h3]Visuals[/h3][p]- Added a "Compass Rose" visual where the map is manipulated to help with navigation[/p][p]- The "Continue" button is grayed out rather than removed if there is no game in progress[/p][p]- Enlarged the hygrometer visual[/p][p]- Enlarged several buttons Interface[/p][p]- Fixed the display of ships when the game is paused, including for ship destruction[/p][p]- Removed the animation for opening the Great Whisperer's bubble between two consecutive displays for greater fluidity[/p][p]- Changed the color of the infrastructure influence zone for greater visibility[/p][p][/p][h3]Sounds[/h3][p]- Fixed ambient sound not playing every time[/p][p]- The Temple sheet sound now plays correctly[/p][p]- Added background sound when the game speed is set to 0[/p][p]- Added sounds when clicking the hygrometer buttons, including hotkeys[/p][p]- Added a smoother transition sound for the music when changing game speed[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice day or evening.[/p]
